motion.name: ledger-rule
motion.purpose: Draw the archive underline on hover or keyboard focus.

components.name: Archive Entry
components.description: A date and wrapping post title in the chronological ledger.
components.css: .ds-archive { display:grid; grid-template-columns:5rem 1fr; gap:2rem; font-family:Arvo,serif; color:#344a38; } .ds-archive time { color:#536858; font-size:.8125rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-archive a { color:currentColor; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-archive a:hover { color:#536858; } .ds-archive a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #244f34; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Text Control
components.description: The localized theme/language control used in the masthead, with an Auto return path.
components.css: .ds-control { min-width:2.75rem; min-height:2.75rem; border:0; background:transparent; color:#536858; font:700 .75rem Arvo,serif; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.25em; cursor:pointer; } .ds-control:hover { color:#344a38; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #244f34; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Article Continuation
components.description: A flat chronological next step with topics and a return to the archive.
components.html: Newer postOlder postBack to the archive
components.css: .ds-continuation { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:1.5rem; padding-top:1.5rem; border-top:1px solid #aeb8aa; font-family:Arvo,serif; color:#344a38; } .ds-continuation a { color:currentColor; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-continuation a:last-child { grid-column:1/-1; color:#536858; font-size:.8rem; text-align:center; } .ds-continuation a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #244f34; outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: The blog is a durable bamboo-paper journal translated directly to the web: restrained, chronological, and led by typography.

rules.name: Bamboo-Ink
rules.body: Derive navigation, links, focus, selection, and browser surfaces from one restrained bamboo-green family.

rules.name: Flat Ledger
rules.body: Do not add shadows, floating cards, translucent layers, or decorative depth.

dos: Do let chronology, whitespace, and typography create hierarchy.
Do wrap long Chinese and English titles at every width.
Do keep persistent controls at a 2.75rem touch target and localize their accessible names.
donts: Don’t use card grids, thumbnails, summaries, or promotional heroes for the archive.
